commands.name: analyze
commands.short_help: Analyze model compute/parameter breakdown (no hardware needed)
commands.help: Analyze model compute/parameter breakdown (no hardware needed)
commands.epilog:
Analyze a .tflite model without hardware:

  hpx analyze model.tflite

  hpx analyze model.tflite --engine helia-aot --board apollo510_evb

  hpx analyze model.tflite --format csv --output analysis.csv

  hpx analyze model.tflite --engine helia-aot --compare

Opens the Joulescope and enables current passthrough so the

target board stays powered.  Holds the connection open until

Ctrl-C.  Useful when the Joulescope app is not running and the

board would otherwise be unpowered.

commands.short_help: Profile a model on target hardware
commands.help: Profile a model on target hardware
commands.epilog:
Quick start:

  hpx profile my_model.tflite

  hpx profile --config hpx.yml

  hpx profile my_model.tflite --engine helia-rt --power -vv

options.name: config

options.help: Increase verbosity

options.help: Engine-specific YAML config

options.help: Tensor arena size in bytes

options.name: runtime_arena_location
options.help: Tensor arena placement. helia-rt: places the single runtime tensor arena. helia-aot: use engine.config.aot_args.memory.tensors instead. Omit to let the engine and memory planner choose.

options.name: runtime_weights_location
options.help: Model weights placement. helia-rt: places the model flatbuffer (psram requires J-Link upload via the RTT transport). helia-aot: use engine.config.aot_args.memory.tensors instead. Omit to let the engine and memory planner choose.

options.name: core_override
options.help: Force heliaRT to use a specific core library variant (e.g. cm4 to disable MVE kernels on an M55 board).

options.name: board
options.help: Target board (default: apollo510_evb)

options.name: toolchain
options.help: Toolchain (default: arm-none-eabi-gcc)

options.name: jlink_serial
options.help: J-Link probe serial number (default: auto-detect)

options.name: transport
options.help: Data transport (default: rtt). RTT is recommended for lossless capture.

options.name: usb_port
options.help: Explicit USB CDC device path for --transport usb_cdc (for example /dev/ttyACM1).

options.name: rtt_buffer_size_up
options.help: SEGGER RTT up-buffer size for generated RTT firmware. If too small, non-blocking writes during timed inference may be dropped, while blocking CSV/HPX_END writes may stall long enough to hit host timeouts. If omitted, hpx uses a toolchain-aware default.

options.name: cpu_clock
options.help: CPU clock speed for generated firmware (board-specific, e.g. 'lp'/'hp'). Default: the board's lowest-power tier.

options.name: frozen
options.help: Deprecated alias for --offline: require the compatible lock and materialized module state without dependency resolution.

options.name: offline
options.help: Require exact compatible lock/module reuse without network resolution.

options.name: update_dependencies
options.help: Explicitly re-resolve dependency refs and rewrite nsx.lock.

options.name: nsx_channel
options.help: NSX channel for module resolution (default: the board's registered channel).

options.name: nsx_module
options.help: Override an NSX module's source. Repeatable. Keys: path (local dir), ref (git ref/tag), version (pin). Examples: --nsx-module nsx-core:path=/my/nsx-core --nsx-module nsx-cmsis-core:ref=feat/new-cmsis --nsx-module nsx-gpio:version=2.0.0

options.name: compiler_launcher
options.help: CMake compiler launcher to cache compiles (e.g. sccache, ccache). 'auto' (default) uses sccache/ccache if installed; a name or path requires it to be found. Overrides build.compiler_launcher; the HPX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER env var overrides both.

options.name: no_compiler_launcher
options.help: Disable the compiler launcher (equivalent to --compiler-launcher none).

options.name: pmu_counters
options.help: PMU counter selection per compute unit. Repeatable. Format: GROUP:SELECT where GROUP is a supported group for the target SoC (for example cpu/mve/memory on Cortex-M55) and SELECT is 'default', 'all', or comma-separated counter names. Examples: --pmu-counters cpu:default --pmu-counters mve:all, --pmu-counters mve:ARM_PMU_MVE_INST_RETIRED,ARM_PMU_MVE_STALL

options.name: per_layer

options.name: iterations

options.name: warmup
options.help: Warmup iterations (default: 5)

options.name: aggregation
options.help: How per-layer counters are aggregated across iterations (default: median). 'median' rejects corrupted iterations; 'trimmed' drops extremes then means; 'mean' is the raw average.

options.name: power_driver

options.name: sync_gpio

options.name: ensure_power

commands.name: validate
commands.short_help: Run hardware-in-the-loop validation suite (MLPerf Tiny models)
commands.help: Run hardware-in-the-loop validation suite (MLPerf Tiny models)
commands.epilog:
Hardware validation — runs canonical MLPerf Tiny models end-to-end

against a real EVB + J-Link (and optional Joulescope).

Examples:

  hpx validate                         # Apollo510 reliability matrix, power off

  hpx validate --list                  # preview what would run

  hpx validate --models kws,ic         # subset by model

  hpx validate --engines aot           # subset by engine

  hpx validate --power off             # skip Joulescope (default)

  hpx validate --boards apollo3p_evb --repeat 2 --power off

                                       # require two passing iterations per case

  hpx validate -k kws-aot              # pytest keyword filter

  hpx validate --suite smoke           # quick preset: kws / helia-rt / gcc / rtt / auto

  hpx validate --suite models-rt       # 16-case RT sweep: 2 boards x 4 models x 2 toolchains

  hpx validate --suite models-aot      # 16-case AOT sweep: 2 boards x 4 models x 2 toolchains

  hpx validate --suite complete        # RT + AOT + TFLM + ExecuTorch sweep

options.name: models
options.help: Comma-separated model IDs (default: all). See `hpx validate --list`.

options.name: models_file
options.help: YAML registry of custom validation models and comparison groups.

options.name: model_paths
options.help: Comma-separated .tflite paths for an ad hoc comparison.

options.name: comparison_group
options.help: Shared decision group for models supplied through --model-paths.

options.name: model_arena_size
options.help: Arena size in bytes for models supplied through --model-paths.

options.name: engines
options.help: Comma-separated engines: rt,aot,tflm,et,executorch,helia-rt,helia-aot (default: all).

options.name: executorch_backends
options.help: ExecuTorch CMSIS-NN providers: arm, ns, or both (default: both). TFLM always uses ARM CMSIS-NN; heliaRT and heliaAOT always use ns-cmsis-nn.

options.name: ns_cmsis_nn_ref
options.help: Exact ns-cmsis-nn commit/ref used by heliaRT, heliaAOT, and ExecuTorch/ns.

options.name: power
options.help: Power matrix: off (default) | on (only Joulescope runs) | both.

options.name: power_boards
options.help: Comma-separated boards allowed to use power capture (default: all selected boards).

options.name: boards
options.help: Comma-separated board IDs (default: apollo510_evb).

options.name: toolchains
options.help: Comma-separated toolchains: gcc,armclang/acfe,atfe (default: board defaults).

options.name: transports
options.help: Comma-separated interfaces/transports: rtt,uart,swo,usb_cdc (default: board defaults).

options.name: memories
options.help: Comma-separated model placement presets: auto,tcm,sram,mram,psram (default: board defaults).

options.name: suite
options.help: Preset suite. 'smoke' defaults unset axes to models=kws, engines=helia-rt, toolchains=arm-none-eabi-gcc, interfaces=rtt, memories=auto. 'models-rt' and 'models-aot' default unset axes to all MLPerf Tiny models, Apollo510 + Apollo330mP, gcc + atfe, rtt, auto memory, and the selected engine. 'complete' runs the same axes for helia-rt, helia-aot, TFLM/CMSIS-NN, and both ExecuTorch CMSIS-NN providers. Explicit axis flags always win.

options.name: jlink_serials
options.help: Comma-separated board=serial entries for multi-board validation.

options.name: power_serials
options.help: Comma-separated board=Joulescope-serial entries for powered multi-board validation.

options.name: power_gpios
options.help: Comma-separated board=gate:state:go entries for powered boards without default sync wiring.

options.name: repeat
options.help: Repeat each selected case N times for stress testing (default: 1).

options.name: output_dir
options.help: Where to write per-case artifacts + summary report (default: ./results/validation).

options.name: timeout
options.help: Per-case timeout in seconds (default: 900).

options.name: keyword
options.help: Pytest keyword expression — filter cases by substring match (e.g. 'kws-aot').

options.name: junit_xml
options.help: Emit JUnit-XML report at this path (for CI consumption).

options.name: list_
options.help: List matching cases and exit without running.
